units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	As you start walking, he answers. "No, I'm an orphan." He sees your confusion and explains. "The Syndicate lets some of us orphans work in industry. In return they give us better schooling, nicer housing, and doctor's visits." He puffs himself up. "Only the cleverest of us get to do it. All of the jobs for orphans are safe too; we don't use big dangerous equipment. Just ordinary stuff, like hammers, soldering irons, or sewing machines.|225|0
